name: lintmax
description: Maximum strictness linting, formatting, and type-checking in one package
author: 1qh

scripts.build:raw: rm -rf node_modules bun.lock dist .cache && bun install --silent && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && printf '#!/usr/bin/env bun\n' | cat - dist/cli.js > dist/cli.tmp && mv dist/cli.tmp dist/cli.js && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.q:install:
mkdir -p node_modules/.bin && printf '%s
' '#!/usr/bin/env bash' 'set -u' '' 'if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then' "  printf '%s\\n' 'Usage: q <command> [args...]' >&2" '  exit 2' 'fi' '' 'out="$("$@" 2>&1)"' 'status=$?' '' 'if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then' '  printf "%s\\n" "$out" >&2' '  exit "$status"' 'fi' > node_modules/.bin/q && chmod +x node_modules/.bin/q
scripts.release: q bun run build && q bun check && q bun run smoke && q bun publish
scripts.release:dry: q bun run build && q bun check && q bun run smoke && q bun publish --dry-run
